name: alarm_validator
intended_use: Down-rank likely-noise alarms before root-cause analysis; the threshold favours keeping true alarms (recall) over removing every noise alarm.
limitations: Trained on synthetic simulator data; separation here is easier than on a real network. In the simulator, test noise alarms never have a neighbour alarm in the prior 5 min (shortcut): PR-AUC is 0.9945 without flap/neighbour counts, and the 0.998 true-class PR-AUC is inflated by a 78% true base rate; the honest number is noise-class AP 0.9675. Calibrated and thresholded on one validation period; needs the KPI z-scores at alarm time (zeros if absent degrades it) and ~10 min of preceding alarms as context.
